root_cause.text: After transferring ownership of dynamically allocated memory to PAT/SDT/EIT tables via assign functions, the local pointers (programs, services, events) were not set to NULL, causing the error cleanup path to attempt to free the same memory again (double-free) or access freed memory (use-after-free) when a subsequent function fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `programs = NULL`, `services = NULL`, `events = NULL` immediately after the corresponding `vidtv_psi_*_assign()` calls. The commit message explicitly states that without this, an error in `vidtv_psi_pmt_create_sec_for_each_pat_entry()` leads to the `free_eit` label where `vidtv_psi_*_event_destroy()` can free already-freed memory via the uninitialized local pointer, causing double-free.
